reference: Approved title screen from this conversation, dark spiky hair, orange jumpsuit, red scarf, teal jetpack; warm lava orange, midnight navy and cyan; polished stylized 3D toy materials.

assets.name: world
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait 2D game background, 1024x1536. Using the reference only for visual style, create a beautiful vertical volcanic canyon for a 2D climbing platformer. Layered navy basalt cliffs on far left and far right, distant ruined tower, turquoise sky and mist high above, lava rivers flowing down the cliffs and orange light from below. THE CENTRAL 60 PERCENT MUST BE OPEN DARK BLUE ATMOSPHERE, low contrast, with no foreground platforms, no hero. The playable platforms and hero will be added by game code. Rich painterly 3D rendered toy aesthetic, dramatic warm/cool lighting, evocative game world. Full bleed. No text, logo, UI or interface. No foreground lava sea. Slightly side-on camera suitable for side-view 2D gameplay.

assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game character sprite sheet, square 1024x1024. Reference image is a visual identity guide only. SAME cheerful original child adventurer, spiky dark brown hair, yellow-orange jumpsuit, red scarf, brown gloves and boots, teal twin jetpack. Exactly FOUR full-body sprites laid out in a precise 2 by 2 equally sized grid, one sprite centered in each quadrant with generous empty padding. Top left: standing idle facing right, three-quarter side view. Top right: leaping facing right, knees bent. Bottom left: running facing right with one leg extended. Bottom right: falling facing right, arms out and feet below. Consistent scale, face, lighting, outfit and camera across all four sprites. Entire body fits inside each quadrant, no overlap. Clean silhouette, polished stylized 3D toy game art. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no ground, no shadows outside character, no text, no grid lines, no frame, no scene.

assets.name: platforms
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D platform game asset sheet, square 1024x1024. Match reference game's volcanic stone and cyan metal materials. Exactly FOUR isolated horizontal platform sprites, a precise 2 by 2 grid, one platform centered per quadrant. Each platform is 3.5 times wider than tall, flat straight level top surface, side-view with a very slight visible top lip. Top left: ordinary charcoal basalt platform with glowing amber cracks and stone edge. Top right: riveted dark metal moving platform with cyan glowing trim. Bottom left: magical translucent cyan glass platform with glimmering edge. Bottom right: cracked fragile terracotta platform with clear fractures, fragments still in place. Consistent angle and scale. Each asset contained in its quadrant with 15 percent clear padding. GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background, no backdrop, no scenery, no text, no UI, no grid, no floor, no directional arrow.

assets.name: lobby
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait mobile game home background, 1024x1536. Match the reference's polished original 3D volcanic fantasy game style and SAME hero identity. A cinematic wide view of a small volcanic expedition base, with the SAME dark-haired boy wearing orange jumpsuit, red scarf and teal jetpack standing full-body on a basalt ledge in lower middle. Hero takes only 30 percent of image height. Towering broken stone obstacle platforms arc upwards in distant blue sky, orange magma rivers at the sides, wisps of clouds, small canvas awning on left. Composition: upper quarter is open atmospheric dark teal sky with room for a game logo; lower quarter dark stone for overlay controls. The hero's face is warmly lit, hopeful, charming. Exceptional mobile game key art. NO TEXT whatsoever, no logo, no UI, no buttons, no interface. Full bleed portrait.

assets.name: items
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent mobile game collectible icon sprite sheet, square 1024x1024. Match original volcanic game reference: friendly polished 3D toy materials, warm orange highlights and cyan accents. Exactly FOUR isolated objects in a precise 2 by 2 grid, each centered with generous padding. Top left: one thick shiny gold coin embossed with a simple star. Top right: delicious triangular rice onigiri with black seaweed, no plate. Bottom left: one appetizing roasted meat leg with bone. Bottom right: compact teal double-cylinder jetpack with metal trim, no flames. Consistent product-style three quarter view, colorful sculpted shapes. Genuine transparent alpha background, no ground, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no frames.

assets.name: enemy
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent enemy sprite for side-view game, square 1024x1024. Original cute small magma golem enemy: round charcoal basalt body and stubby legs, glowing orange cracks, two amber eyes and mischievous expression, chunky stone fists, tiny orange crystals on shoulders. Friendly family game enemy, polished 3D toy rendering matching reference. Full body centered, three quarter side view facing left. Occupy 75 percent of canvas with clean silhouette. Genuine transparent alpha background. No platform, no ground shadow outside feet, no text, no frame, no additional character.

assets.name: gacha
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait in-game gacha backdrop, 1024x1536. In a cozy volcanic treasure workshop, a spectacular original capsule vending machine crafted from midnight basalt and brass, luminous cyan glass dome filled with glowing orange, violet and cyan capsules, a large orange crank, lava veins in the base. One softly glowing gold capsule floats above the machine. Rich magical particles, beautiful 3D game render, friendly premium mobile game feel matching the reference. Machine occupies central 60 percent, top 20 percent and bottom 20 percent dark simple background reserved for coded UI. No text, no logos, no letters, no embedded interface or buttons. Full bleed portrait.

assets.name: icon
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square mobile game app icon 1024x1024. Close-up face and shoulders of the SAME reference hero: smiling child adventurer with spiky dark brown hair, orange suit, flowing red scarf and small teal jetpack edge. Behind him a simple vivid orange lava eruption and dark navy mountain silhouette. Strong clear silhouette readable at tiny size, polished original 3D toy art, warm amber and cyan light. Full bleed square, no rounded corners baked in, no text, no letters, no border, no UI.
